choose-a-dated-play.text: Choose a dated preprod play and check its evidence boundary. Cardano KERI uses its follower store for identity actions, while Singular needs a persistent registry read path. Each cast requires real keripy and Cardano KERI operations plus the released Singular transactions and readbacks.

planned-major-release-tags.text: The registry handoff targets Singular version one point zero point zero. Naming and escrow target version two point zero point zero after the connected D zero three gate. These are planned tags, not published releases.
